messages:
Priya: Heads-up: tea tin is basically empty again — only Earl Grey dust left. Who's the tea pirate? :eyes:
Sam: Guilty? 😂 sorry, grabbed the last chamomile. Can we put a 'replace when you take the last box' sticky on the tin?
Jen: Maybe a simple signup/IOU board? Or we do a weekly snack budget + rotation? I'm ok managing the tea stash if ppl chip in a few $.
Alex: @Priya @Sam Also noticed spice rack jars unlabeled and some herbs expired. Did a quick inventory: `oregano - low`, `turmeric - expired`, `vanilla - missing`
Priya: Yes to labels. Can we get clear jars and a label maker? @kitchen-bot can you add `labels + clear jars` to office supply list?
kitchen-bot: Added 'labels, 6x clear spice jars (200ml), small label-maker' to supplies list. ETA: 6 days. :white_check_mark:
Sam: I'll bring a small tea sampler (6 varieties) tomorrow if people agree to a $5 pooled contribution? Venmo @sam-espresso
Jen: Count me in. Also proposing a 'no mystery tupperware' policy + spice audit every quarter. :raised_hands:
Priya: Perfect. I'll stick a note on the tin: 'Last box? replace or ping #lunch-plans' + put a mini checklist inside. Thanks y'all :heart:
